title: Take and Replace
goal: Swap a String stored inside a Cell without requiring Copy.
hints: Cell does not offer get() when T is not Copy, error E0277.
Use a method that takes ownership of the current String, then set the replacement.
explanation: Cell works with non-`Copy` types like `String`, but `get` requires `Copy` because it duplicates the value. `take` replaces the contents with `Default::default()` and moves the original `String` out. `set` then puts the new `String` into the cell. Using `replace` in slot 1 moves `new_msg`, causing error `E0382` when slot 2 tries to use `new_msg` again.
